message.content: {"linkedin": "Planning to tackle the Tongariro Alpine Crossing soon? This 19.4 km day walk usually takes between 6 and 8 hours to complete. Because weather on the saddle can change rapidly, it pays to be prepared by packing a rain shell, a warm layer, a hat, and gloves, even during the summer months. You will also need to carry at least 2 litres of water per person as there are no refills along the track. Our Trailhead 45L pack has plenty of room for all your gear and lunch. Remember to check the forecast, book your shuttle in advance, and start early.
